verdict.rationale: Fireworks publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document ("Gateway REST API", v5.10.0) at docs.fireworks.ai/gateway.openapi.yaml. It covers account, deployment, model and training endpoints, and llms.txt lists it under "OpenAPI Specs" alongside anthropic-messages and gateway-extra specs, so it is machine-discoverable. The probe's 404s on conventional paths such as /openapi.json only show the spec lives at a non-standard path; they do not contradict its existence. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the published specs cover the OpenAI-compatible chat/inference endpoints, a spec at conventional/well-known paths, and independent hands-on corroboration of downloading the spec.
